body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Anderson Hardwood Floor(www.amderpnfloors.com) showcased its three 'Permacolor' collections to the North American retail trade at Surfaces 2009.

PermaColor is an exclusive natural shading process that adds color to hardwoods without stains, chemicals, pigments or solvents. This unique process colors the entire veneer, not just the surface, for a true through-color. Furthermore, unlike traditional stains there are no pigments to mask the natural beauty of the hardwood grain, even on the darkest colors. Finally, because no chemicals or solvents are used the finished product is one of the most environmentally friendly hardwood flooring products on the market.

Included in the introductions is 'Anderson Exotic Impressions Classic', a satin gloss, wide-width, plank that reproduce the look of popular exotic hardwoods from abundant, renewable, domestic, North American species. Available in 7 colors, Afromosia Brown, Santos Red, Jatoba Sunrise, Shades of Ipe, Teak Effect, Mango Maple, and Tigerwood Birch.

A second introduction is 'Anderson Exotic Impressions Handscraped'. Picture the same beautiful, Classic Exotic plank above, in the same 7 exotic colors and then individually hand-scrape them board-by-board, piece-by-piece, as only Anderson can.

The final PermaColor introduction is in Anderson's Appalachian line and is called 'Tropical Reflections'. While the two introductions above produce classic, and rustic exotic looks to using the PermaColor process, 'Tropical Reflections' is bright, shinny and contemporary.
